name: PAN: Physics of Atomic Nuclei (FRIB, Michigan State University)
org: Facility for Rare Isotope Beams (FRIB), Michigan State University
what_you_do: Spend a week at a top nuclear physics lab. You do hands-on activities and experiments with FRIB scientists and students, learn how atomic nuclei connect to stars and space, explore science careers and get a taste of college life.
who_can_apply: High school students in grades 9 to 12 in the United States.
pay_detail: Free. Room and board on campus are provided free if you need them. It does not pay a wage.
duration: About 1 week in late July. PAN 2027 is planned for July 18 to 23, 2027.
deadline_text: The application is posted each December on the FRIB PAN page, with a deadline in early March. PAN 2027 is planned for July 18 to 23, 2027. The exact 2027 deadline is not posted yet.
how_to_apply: When the application is posted in December, fill out the online form (a Qualtrics survey) on the FRIB PAN page and ask two teachers for recommendations. Questions: the FRIB Outreach Coordinator, constan@frib.msu.edu or 517-908-7363.
notes: Read on the FRIB page in a browser on 2026-10-16. The 2027 dates (July 18 to 23) are planned, not final. The application opens in December, so check back then. Contact from the Spartan Youth listing: Zach Constan, constan@frib.msu.edu or 517-908-7363.
